responsibility: This header declares the front end’s intrinsic-procedure interface: check functions for validating intrinsic arguments, simplification and resolution entry points for individual intrinsics and intrinsic subroutines, and shared state describing the intrinsic currently under examination. It is the main contract between parsing/resolution code and the large intrinsic catalog implemented across intrinsic-related source files.
same_name_distinction: Declares the compiler-side intrinsic interface: check, simplify, and resolve entry points plus shared state about the currently checked intrinsic. Unlike gcc/fortran/intrinsic.cc, it does not build or resolve the intrinsic catalog itself, and unlike gcc/fortran/intrinsic.texi, it is internal API rather than user documentation.
